emails.subject: Seeking pre-seed funding for B2B SaaS startup
emails.body:
Hi Eximius,

I am the founder of a B2B SaaS startup focused on invoice reconciliation, with 40 paying customers and Rs 25 lakh ARR. We are preparing to raise pre-seed funding to scale further.

Eximius VC invests in SaaS startups at the pre-seed and seed stages, which aligns with our current funding needs. Could you please share how I might apply for pre-seed or seed funding through Eximius Ventures or if an introduction to the relevant team member is possible? A brief call to discuss this would be appreciated.

Best regards,
Test Founder
